list.title: Scores
list.description: A score is an evaluation of a trace or observation. It can be created from user feedback, model-based evaluations, or manual review.
list.name: Name
list.author: Author
list.deletedDescription: Selected scores will be deleted. Scores are removed asynchronously and may continue to be visible for up to 15 minutes.

configs.title: Score Configs
configs.description: Score configs define which scores are available for annotation in your project. Please note that all score configs are immutable.
configs.errorCreating: An error occurred while creating config.
configs.errorUpdating: An error occurred while updating config.
configs.fieldDescriptionPlaceholder: Provide an optional description of the score config...
configs.name: Name
configs.label: Label
configs.archiveDescription: Your config is currently active. Archive if you no longer want to use "{name}" in annotation. Historic "{name}" scores will still be shown and can be deleted. You can restore your config at any point.
configs.restoreDescription: Your config is currently archived. Restore if you want to use "{name}" in annotation again.

annotationQueues.title: Annotation Queues
annotationQueues.description: Annotation queues are used to manage scoring workflows for your LLM projects.
annotationQueues.name: Name
annotationQueues.confirmRemoveFromQueue: Are you sure you want to remove this item from the queue "{queueName}"?
annotationQueues.deleteQueueConfirmDescription: This action cannot be undone and removes queue items attached to this queue. Scores added while annotating in this queue will not be deleted.
annotationQueues.createQueueDescription: Create a new queue to manage your annotation workflows.
annotationQueues.editQueueDescription: Edit queue to manage your annotation workflows.
annotationQueues.scoreConfigsDescription: Define which dimensions annotators should score for the given queue.
annotationQueues.deleteQueueItemsDescription: This action cannot be undone and removes the selected annotation queue item(s), but does not delete associated scores.
annotationQueues.detailedViewDisabled: Detailed view is only available for traces and observations
annotationQueues.sourceTooltip: Link to the source trace, observation or session based on which this item was added
annotationQueues.noMoreItems: No more items left to annotate!
annotationQueues.itemDeleted: Item has been deleted from annotation queue. Previously added scores and underlying reference trace are unaffected by this action.

annotate.title: Annotate
annotate.scoreArchivedDescription: This action will delete your score irreversibly.
annotate.apiEvalScoresNote: API and eval scores visible on left. Add manual annotations above.
annotate.apiEvalScoresDetailedNote: API and eval scores visible when toggling on the detailed view. Add manual annotations above.

actions.deleteScoresDescription: This action permanently deletes scores and cannot be undone. Score deletion happens asynchronously and may take up to 15 minutes.
